note: Authored game dialogue for fictional characters. The Bednar character's lines are NOT real quotes. Montage text is labelled fiction except the cited opening year.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Our campus is growing. I have two blueprints that need careful hands.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: One is the John Taylor Building. Its site is fenced off and waiting for the right plan.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: The other is a great gathering place west of the Manwaring Center. Solve both blueprints, then report back.

readyReminder: Both blueprints are solved? Tell me what you found.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: The Taylor Building and the Campus Center both stand now. Thank you.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: Let's see what the years bring to this campus.
